Name: Haley as Yang Xiao Long
Author: wolffang719
Description:
This is a mod I made after surfing around a bit on the Nexus and Chucklefish forums and I noticed there was some interest in making some things in Stardew Valley look like RWBY but oddly enough there were no sprite changes for characters (excepting one made by LittleDipper618 to make Penny into... Penny) so I thought I'd take a swing at it and this is the first in (what may become) a series of sprite changes to make the Bachelorettes and Bachelors into characters from RWBY with custom dialogue. 
New Portrait made by editing work by Reiforce on DeviantArt (with his permission of course.)

Downloads.Description:
Haley as Yang Xiao Long with beach sprites and cow pictures.
(Cow pics might need work but otherwise seems functional)
